summary: Backend and mobile-web UI retest completed for the requested family-profile, invitation gate, About page, and Sur le vif rename/re-assign features. Backend rules pass (10/10). Frontend key flows pass except a blocking invitation-management UI regression: pending invitations do not expose revoke/resend actions in Membres.

ui_bugs.issue: After sending an invitation from UI, pending card appears but revoke/resend buttons are missing, so owner cannot revoke from UI.

integration_issues.issue: Backend invitation creation works, but frontend cannot map pending member to invitation actions (UI list shows pending item without controls).

action_items: Fix members pending-invitation mapping in frontend (currently matched by display_name); map by invitation.member_id or include display_name in GET /api/circle/invitations response.
Retest revoke/resend buttons visibility and click path after fix.
Optional regression check: rerun one end-to-end voice save on real device/browser with microphone permission (not fully executable in this web automation run).
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/members.tsx: pending invitation action rendering relies on `invitesQ.data?.find((entry) => entry.display_name === item.display_name)`. Backend invitation payload does not reliably provide `display_name`, causing missing revoke/resend controls.
backend/server.py invitation gate logic is correct: before 4 direct profiles returns 400; at 4 direct profiles invitation succeeds.
backend/server.py circle/profile and capsule update endpoints consistently strip `_id` via clean(), and backend tests confirmed no Mongo ObjectId leakage in tested responses.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (major requested flows pass, invitation revoke UI blocked)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_i6_* accounts and circles through public API/UI, including circles with 4 direct profiles and pending invites for validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: During UI run with profils@racontelle.fr, deleting a managed profile succeeded (counter became 3/4), and a pending invite card remained visible but without revoke action controls. Counter behavior on fresh setup is correct (4/4 after waiting for members query).
rca_of_issue: RCA: Pending invitation actions are derived by matching member display_name against invitation display_name in frontend. Backend invitation documents do not consistently include display_name, so `invitation` resolves undefined and resend/revoke buttons are not rendered. Repro: login owner with 4/4 direct -> open Membres -> send invitation -> observe pending card but no action icons; expected resend/revoke controls.
